How Teacher Payroll Works:

Every teacher's hourly rate is securely configured. At the end of the month, simply type the lectures they took into the Lectures Attended box or use the + / - steppers. The system automatically multiplies: Lectures × Hourly Rate = Total Payout. Everything persists in your browser and updates all totals in real time!
